import json, os, sys, math, statistics, fractions, textwrap, platform

from fractions import Fraction

import matplotlib

groups_in = data["groups"]
values_all = data["values"]
style = data["plot_config"]["style"]
presentation = data["presentation"]

# Strict numeric helpers
def as_fraction(x):
    # Convert through string to preserve decimal input semantics.
    return Fraction(str(x))

def finite_float(fr):
    try:
        x = float(fr)
    except (OverflowError, ValueError):
        return None
    return x if math.isfinite(x) else None

def quantile_fraction(vals, p):
    s = sorted(as_fraction(v) for v in vals)
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    if n == 1:
        return s[0]
    pos = Fraction(n - 1) * p
    lo = pos.numerator // pos.denominator
    hi = math.ceil(pos)
    if lo == hi:
        return s[lo]
    w = pos - lo
    return s[lo] + (s[hi] - s[lo]) * w

def stats_for(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    if n == 0:
        return {"n": 0, "mean": None, "std": None, "min": None, "q1": None,
                "median": None, "q3": None, "max": None, "iqr": None}
    q1f = quantile_fraction(vals, Fraction(1,4))
    medf = quantile_fraction(vals, Fraction(1,2))
    q3f = quantile_fraction(vals, Fraction(3,4))
    iqrf = q3f - q1f
    mean_v = statistics.mean(vals)
    try:
        std_v = statistics.stdev(vals) if n > 1 else None
    except (OverflowError, statistics.StatisticsError):
        std_v = None
    def ff(x):
        try:
            y=float(x)
            return y if math.isfinite(y) else None
        except (OverflowError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return None
    return {
        "n": n,
        "mean": ff(mean_v),
        "std": ff(std_v),
        "min": ff(min(vals)),
        "q1": finite_float(q1f),
        "median": finite_float(medf),
        "q3": finite_float(q3f),
        "max": ff(max(vals)),
        "iqr": finite_float(iqrf),
    }

def series_for(label, vals):
    n=len(vals)
    if n == 0:
        return {"label": label, "n": 0, "q1": None, "median": None, "q3": None,
                "whislo": None, "whishi": None, "fliers": [], "outlier_count": 0}
    sf=sorted(as_fraction(v) for v in vals)
    q1=quantile_fraction(vals, Fraction(1,4))
    med=quantile_fraction(vals, Fraction(1,2))
    q3=quantile_fraction(vals, Fraction(3,4))
    iqr=q3-q1
    # Inclusive fences, entirely in Fraction arithmetic
    low_fence=q1-Fraction(3,2)*iqr
    high_fence=q3+Fraction(3,2)*iqr
    inside=[v for v in sf if low_fence <= v <= high_fence]
    outside=[v for v in sf if v < low_fence or v > high_fence]
    distinct=sorted(set(outside))
    return {
        "label": label,
        "n": n,
        "q1": finite_float(q1),
        "median": finite_float(med),
        "q3": finite_float(q3),
        "whislo": finite_float(min(inside)),
        "whishi": finite_float(max(inside)),
        "fliers": [finite_float(v) for v in distinct],
        "outlier_count": len(outside),
    }

overall = stats_for(values_all)
group_results = [{"label": g["label"], "statistics": stats_for(g["values"])} for g in groups_in]
series = [series_for(g["label"], g["values"]) for g in groups_in] if groups_in else [series_for("总体", values_all)]

overall, group_results, series
# Choose a font that covers all supplied text characters.
all_text_parts = [
    labels["title"], labels["x_label"], labels["y_label"], labels["caption"],
    presentation["axes"]["x"]["label"], presentation["axes"]["x"]["unit"],

]
for e in presentation["legend"]["entries"]:

for a in presentation["abbreviations"]:

all_chars=set("".join(all_text_parts))

candidate_names=["DejaVu Sans","Noto Sans CJK SC","Noto Sans CJK JP","Liberation Sans"]
chosen=None
missing_by_font={}
for name in candidate_names:

        missing_by_font[name]=missing
        if not missing:
            chosen=(name,fp)
            break
    except Exception as e:
        missing_by_font[name]=str(e)
chosen, missing_by_font

# Plot configuration

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(W/DPI,H/DPI),dpi=DPI,facecolor="white")

# Dedicated non-overlapping regions: plot left, legend right, explanatory text below.
ax=fig.add_axes([0.105,0.44,0.66,0.42])

# Input display order is empty, so preserve input order; top-to-bottom.
positions=list(range(len(series),0,-1))
bxp_stats=[]

artists=ax.bxp(

                    markersize=6, linestyle="none", markeredgewidth=1.2),
)

legend_entries=presentation["legend"]["entries"]
colors=[e["color"] for e in legend_entries]
for patch,color in zip(artists["boxes"],colors):

ax.set_yticks(positions)
ax.set_yticklabels([f'{s["label"]} (n={s["n"]})' for s in series])

ax.grid(axis="x", color="#D9D9D9", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8)

# Ensure every observation is within the view, with modest linear padding.
finite_vals=[float(v) for v in values_all if math.isfinite(float(v))]

if vmin==vmax:

else:

ax.set_xlim(vmin-pad,vmax+pad)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(nbins=7))
ax.ticklabel_format(axis="x", style="plain", useOffset=False)
ax.set_ylim(0.45,len(series)+0.55)

# Exact title.
title_artist=fig.text(0.105,0.925,labels["title"],ha="left",va="top",

# Dedicated legend region outside data axes.

         for e in legend_entries]
legend=fig.legend(handles=handles,labels=[e["label"] for e in legend_entries],

legend.get_frame().set_facecolor("white")

# Wrap caption and abbreviations while preserving every supplied character.

abbr_raw="Abbreviations: " + "; ".join(
